create.name: Blue Lotus Buddhist Temple
create.bio:
Blue Lotus Buddhist Temple is a community temple and meditation centre near the town square of Woodstock, Illinois, about an hour north-west of Chicago. Its founder and abbot is Bhante Sujatha, a monk from Kandy in Sri Lanka trained in the Theravada tradition, who taught in Brisbane before coming to the United States; he started leading meditation classes in Woodstock in 2003, at the local college and the Unitarian church, and the temple grew from those groups. It welcomes people of every faith and none.

The heart of its programme is an hour-long guided session several times a week that pairs loving-kindness (metta) meditation with mindfulness practice and closes with chanting led by the monastics. Around these it runs a monthly introduction to Buddhism, Dhammapada and sutta study classes on Zoom, one-to-one guidance for beginners by appointment and a children's class, with satellite sitting groups in Elkhorn, Wisconsin and Geneva, Illinois. A small team of resident and visiting monastics supports the work, and dharma talks by Bhante Sujatha and other teachers are posted on the temple's YouTube channel, which it has kept since 2010.
